describe: C3 + unloading response to sudden ankle rotation (Konradsen & Ravn 1990; 67 ms proprioceptive channel; graded 85–300 °/s; stance intent withdrawn; peroneal reflex 0.3 × capacity)

amendments.what: LOAD family re-run with the corrected onset (first impactor contact; the constant preload is not the onset) and impactor-only impulse (s1_metrics.mjs)

LOAD family REPLACED: preload ±60 N → ±40 N (the ±60 N twins fall in ≈ 2 s under the constant preload alone — a C3 lateral-lean limit; ±40 N twins stand, load shares ≈ 26/74 %); onset = first impactor contact
amendments.twinsNote: each LOAD run is compared with the twin under the same preload
